learning_outcomes.text: The student gets to know the company where the internship takes place.
Examines research and development, quality control, maintenance and repair, production planning, purchasing, and marketing departments in detail.
Creates management organization and workflow diagrams.
Performs time study work on the assembly line.
Examines the company's energy facilities and auxiliary facilities (compressor, heater, evaporator, etc.) in terms of capacity.
